text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
Panel size is SERVICE-enforced, not a DB rule.
DB has only uk_maqam_teacher_one_vote_per_song
on list_of_maqam_id + teacher_user_id.
applyTeacherRoster throws MaqamValidationException
outside MIN_TEACHERS=1 .. MAX_TEACHERS=3, but a
record created without a roster keeps 0 vote rows,
so the drawn multiplicity is 0..3.
deleteVote nulls maqamType/teacherNote/votedAt;
it does not remove the row.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
Only the panel, vote and listen actions are shown.
The enum also carries the record-CRUD family
CREATE READ LIST SEARCH UPDATE REMOVE
DELETE RESTORE PURGE.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
Gated by authorities, not roles: maqam:vote for
vote and listen start/progress/end, maqam:read for
listen-summary, sessions and stream.
MaqamService then re-checks Role.TEACHER AND panel
membership, so maqam:vote alone is never enough.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
Sessions outlive votes: dropping a teacher from the
roster orphan-removes their MaqamTeacherVote while
these rows remain, so recordProgress tolerates a
missing vote and simply skips the rollup.
secondsListened is advance-time, not wall-clock, and
the duration clamp is per session, so the sum across
sessions can exceed audioDurationSeconds.
